edit.description: `normalize_instructions_loaded_identity` (19-37) misses the lock's `path_to_id` map and falls back to `file_name()` + `strip_suffix(".md")` (28-36) — a second implementation of the bare-stem member id the crate's one path→id folder already owns, `extract::fold_file_id` (src/extract.rs:940), whose documented degradation is exactly that: a source carrying no placement below the fold base keeps its bare filename stem. The hit path is already folder-derived (the map is keyed by the lock's folded ids, src/read.rs:2482; pinned at tests/it/read_verbs.rs:2153), so routing the miss through the same folder is what makes the whole join one derivation. Call it with the identity's own parent as the fold base — the one base that carries no placement, so every `.md` identity yields today's id byte-for-byte — and keep the raw identity on a `UnitIdFault`. The `.md` literal goes with the hand-roll: `file_stem` is format-agnostic, so a non-markdown identity folds to its stem instead of falling through as a whole path. The module already imports `crate::extract`; `fold_file_id` is `pub(crate)`.

A test for the miss path, which has none today: an `InstructionsLoaded` record whose repo-relative path is absent from `path_to_id` joins to its flat member by the bare stem. Only the hit path is pinned (`a_nested_instructions_loaded_record_joins_to_its_placement_folded_member_id`, 2153), so the branch this entry rewrites would otherwise ship unpinned — and the assertion names a count, not just the strand, so the join is proven non-vacuous.

summary: telemetry's InstructionsLoaded identity fallback hand-rolls a markdown-only stem beside extract::fold_file_id, the crate's one path-to-id folder

tests.asserts: an `InstructionsLoaded` record naming `.claude/rules/rust.md` with that path absent from the lock's path-to-id map still joins to member `rust` and narrates a non-zero count for it; the nested placement-folded join at 2153 stays green

acceptance: cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check green; `rg -a 'strip_suffix\("\.md"\)' src/` returns nothing and every member id the field strand joins by comes out of `extract::fold_file_id`.
